entries.title: Who Pillow AI is
entries.tags: кто ты who are you pillow ai assistant ассистент создатель создал кто сделал made by arilax kaban авторы
entries.text: Pillow AI is the assistant of Pillow Hub. It was made and trained by ARILAX and KABAN. It runs fully on the user's device in the browser (WebLLM + WebGPU): free, no account, files never leave the device. It knows the Pillow tools, TikTok quality and After Effects export, and can run the site tools right in the chat.

entries.text: Telegram channels: @arilaxscp (ARILAX), @kaban_shashluk (KABAN), @pillowex (Pillow). Telegram bot: @pillow_hub_bot.

entries.title: Telegram bot @pillow_hub_bot
entries.tags: бот bot pillow_hub_bot получить расширение get extension подписка subscription /extension mini app
entries.text: @pillow_hub_bot gives the Pillow After Effects extension after you subscribe to the channels; send /extension. The bot can also open the site as a Telegram Mini App. On the site the ZIP is also on the Extension page.

entries.title: Pillow — After Effects extension
entries.tags: расширение extension панель panel after effects ae что умеет features curves bounce text relink sound effects music liquid glass
entries.text: Pillow is a free After Effects panel (macOS and Windows, After Effects 2021 or later): Create (layers in one click, parent, match comp duration, move anchor), Curves (easing presets and point editor), Bounce (overshoot after keyframes), Text animations, Relink (finds missing files), Sound Effects (42 sounds), Music (a marker on every beat plus beat-synced effects), Liquid Glass (Apple-style glass from native AE effects). Current build: Pillow v192, panel 1.1.1.

entries.title: Installing the extension
entries.tags: установить установка install как поставить cep debug mode панель не появляется not showing extensions folder папка
entries.text: 1) Turn on CEP debug mode once: run enable-debug/Enable-CEP-Debug-Mac.command (Mac) or Enable-CEP-Debug-Windows.reg (Windows) from the archive. 2) Put the Pillow folder into ~/Library/Application Support/Adobe/CEP/extensions (Mac) or %APPDATA%\Adobe\CEP\extensions (Windows). 3) Fully restart After Effects. 4) Window → Extensions → Pillow. If it does not show: debug mode must be 1, the path must end with /CEP/extensions/Pillow/, delete an old com.pillow.panel folder.

entries.title: Upload Method page
entries.tags: метод method upload загрузка тикток tiktok studio качество quality enhanced max quality какой выбрать which
entries.text: Method prepares a video for TikTok, locally. Two options: Enhanced Method · Pillow AI (Pillow AI cleans and refines the clip, Full HD, gives an upload file plus a compatible MP4) and Max Quality · 1080p (keeps a clean H.264 ≤1080p bit-for-bit, otherwise encodes once to a high-bitrate H.264 High master up to 24–30 Mbps with AAC 320k, then patches the MP4 container: moov first, mvhd duration64). Upload the result in TikTok Studio on a computer. TikTok changes processing often, results can vary.

entries.title: Max Quality (1080p)
entries.tags: max quality максимальное качество максимальный вес битрейт bitrate patch патч duration64 1080p 60 fps
entries.text: Max Quality: up to 1080p and 60 FPS. Clean H.264 sources are kept as they are; others become one high-bitrate master. The container is patched the way current public methods do it (CompressBase-style duration64: mvhd v1 with unknown duration, ftyp→moov→mdat). Streams are untouched by the patch. Use TikTok Studio on desktop. As of November 2026 sources report these methods as unstable or patched at times.

entries.title: Enhanced Method · Pillow AI
entries.tags: enhanced энхансед pillow ai шумоподавление denoise ts full hd компатибл compatible
entries.text: Enhanced Method: Pillow AI reads the clip (noise, detail), denoises or restores detail if needed and writes Full HD. You get the upload file and a compatible MP4. Built for uploading from TikTok Studio on a computer.

entries.title: Pillow AI Enhancer (Tools)
entries.tags: энхансер enhancer апскейл upscale 2k 4k h265 hevc увеличить разрешение resolution tools
entries.text: Tools → Pillow AI Enhancer: sizes are 2K (short side 1440) and 4K (short side 2160), relative to the source; a size the source already reaches is disabled. Output is H.265 through the device encoder (Chrome/Edge on Windows/macOS, Safari); without an HEVC encoder it saves H.264 and says so. All settings are picked automatically. Up to 256 MB, 10 minutes. It is adaptive processing, not a generative Topaz-class model.

entries.title: Auto Beats (Tools)
entries.tags: биты beats auto beats маркеры markers bpm jsx after effects музыка music трек track
entries.text: Tools → Auto Beats: drop audio or video, beats are detected automatically and shown on a waveform. Download for After Effects (.jsx): File → Scripts → Run Script File; markers go on the selected layer, or on the comp. Re-running replaces Pillow markers, one undo step. Copy seconds copies the times. Panel .json goes to the Pillow panel: Music → Import from Pillow Hub.

entries.title: Import from Pillow Hub (panel)
entries.tags: импорт import from pillow hub json панель panel music маркеры
entries.text: In the Pillow panel open Music → Import from Pillow Hub and pick the .pillow-beats.json saved by Auto Beats. Needs panel 1.1 or newer.

entries.title: What Pillow AI can do in chat
entries.tags: что умеешь what can you do действия actions файл file перетащи drop
entries.text: Drop a video or audio into the chat and say what you want: 'max quality for TikTok', 'enhanced', 'upscale to 2K/4K', 'find beats, give me jsx'. Pillow AI runs the same tools as the site and returns download cards. Everything stays on the device.

entries.title: TikTok quality tips
entries.tags: тикток tiktok качество quality мыло blur размытие советы tips залить upload studio компьютер 1080 60fps
entries.text: Upload from TikTok Studio on a computer, not the phone app. Export 1080×1920 (9:16). Keep 30 or 60 FPS constant. Avoid re-encoding several times: export once at high quality, then use Method. Strong grain and heavy noise get smeared by TikTok; light denoise helps. Fine text and thin lines survive better slightly bolder. Check the result on a phone after TikTok finishes processing.

entries.title: After Effects export settings
entries.tags: экспорт export after effects ae render рендер media encoder настройки settings h264 prores
entries.text: Render from After Effects to a high-quality intermediate (ProRes 422 HQ or lossless), then encode once: H.264 High or H.265, 1080×1920, the comp FPS, VBR 2-pass around 20–40 Mbps for H.264, AAC 320 kbps 48 kHz. Do not upscale in AE at render; enhance afterwards if needed.

entries.title: HEVC / x265 settings
entries.tags: hevc h265 x265 psy-rd aq-mode ffmpeg handbrake настройки settings crf
entries.text: Recommended x265 settings for edits: psy-rd=1.0, aq-mode=3, CRF 16–20, preset slow or slower, 10-bit if the target supports it. FFmpeg: ffmpeg -i in.mov -c:v libx265 -preset slow -crf 18 -x265-params psy-rd=1.0:aq-mode=3 -tag:v hvc1 -c:a aac -b:a 320k out.mp4. HandBrake: H.265 (x265), RF 18, preset Slow, Advanced options: psy-rd=1.0:aq-mode=3.

entries.title: HandBrake
entries.tags: handbrake хендбрейк хэндбрейк настройки
entries.text: HandBrake: Video codec H.265 (x265) or H.264 (x264), Constant Quality RF 16–20, Preset Slow, Framerate Same as source + Constant, resolution unchanged. Audio AAC 320 kbps. Advanced options for x265: psy-rd=1.0:aq-mode=3.

entries.title: Topaz Video
entries.tags: topaz топаз upscale апскейл proteus artemis
entries.text: Topaz Video: upscale to the target size first, export ProRes or a high-bitrate file, then do the final H.264/H.265 encode once. Keep the original frame rate unless you need frame interpolation. Exact model names change between Topaz versions; pick by preview.

entries.title: Motion-heavy edits
entries.tags: motion движение 1440x1080 4:3 fast motion динамика шейк shake
entries.text: For motion-heavy 4:3 edits a common choice is 1440×1080 with high bitrate and HEVC (x265 psy-rd=1.0, aq-mode=3). Motion blur and constant frame rate keep fast motion clean after TikTok compression.

entries.title: Fan-edit tips
entries.tags: эдит edit фан эдит fan edit советы tips переходы transitions синхрон sync биты velocity
entries.text: Cut on beats: run Auto Beats and import the markers. Keep the hook in the first second. Use velocity/ease for rhythm, not just cuts. Clean sources matter most: start from the highest quality clip you can get. Do color and sharpening lightly; TikTok exaggerates noise. Export once at high quality, then use Method.

entries.title: Privacy and cost
entries.tags: приватность privacy бесплатно free цена price данные data офлайн offline
entries.text: Pillow Hub tools and Pillow AI are free. Video, audio and chat stay on the device; the AI model downloads once from Hugging Face and is cached by the browser.

entries.title: Pillow AI models
entries.tags: модель model скачать download размер size webgpu не работает doesn't work lite
entries.text: Pillow AI uses Qwen3.5 2B (about 1.1 GB download, about 2.2 GB of GPU memory) by default and Qwen3.5 0.8B Lite (about 0.45 GB) for weaker devices. It needs WebGPU: current Chrome, Edge or Safari on a Mac with Apple Silicon works best. Without WebGPU the tools in chat still work.
